## Resources

As far as it is considered, the reading list covers the reading requirement already. However, for logistics, 

- [The Universal Guideline on Artificial Automata](https://github.com/Amane-Fujimiya/UAI_Book) - still under construction, is the foremost document itself. The name is again, Amane Fujimiya or Bui Gia Khanh (as I use two names), and is more about theoretical attempts on AI theory in its entirety. So far, [this link will be the one](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/web/viewer.html?file=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Amane-Fujimiya/UAI_Book/master/A/A1.AI/A1%20-%20UAI/main.pdf) that gives you the last available rendered manuscript of the book (note that it is on the `master` branch). 
- **Main manuscript** - constructed on [This Particular Repository (TPR)](https://github.com/Amane-Fujimiya/ML_Double_Descent_Paper) of which holds from the first to the last manuscript. Current active manuscript in total is the `Draft` folder itself document. Alongside that, [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2103.05127) would form chapter 6 of the manuscript itself. The manuscript of the *Theoretical Learning manuscript* of **this project** can be found [in here](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/web/viewer.html?file=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Amane-Fujimiya/ML_Double_Descent_Paper/main/Draft/main.pdf) of its latest version. 
- The code repository includes [this one on GitHub](https://github.com/Izzie1911/DD-with-basic-model-), with its copy and extension on GitLab. The link will be routed later.
